  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOV/DEC 2023  
  Natural Language Processing [CSE-3172]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           What is Lemmatization? Explain how lemmatization is used in NLP with an example.  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      What is Morphorlogy? Explain Compounding morphemes with a suitable example.                   (3)  
  C)      Differentiate between Finite state automaton and finite state transducer?                     (4)  
  2)           What are grammatical relations in English Language?  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Draw finite state transducer (FST) which recognises the suffix -fy associated with  
  regular adverbs in English. Demonstrate that your FST will handles cases like 'class'→        (5)  
  'classify'  
  
  C)      What is a regular expression? Write a regular expression to find the test of the form dd/  
  mm/yyyy in the text                                                                           (2)  
  
  3)           Find the minimum edit distance from illustration to frustration, if cost of insert, delete  
  is 3, and substitute cost is 5?  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      Explain dynamic programming class of minimum edit distance algorithm used for  
  spelling correction with a suitable example.                                                  (5)  
  
  C)      What is the significance of parts-of-speech for language processing?                          (2)  
  4)           How can you address the issue of zero probabilities in a dataset when dealing with n-  
  grams that are not available?  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)      For the given sentences:                                                                      (5)  
  
  • Cats are lovely creatures

  • Dogs are loyal companions  
  • Companionship is important  
  • Lovely days are great  
  
  Learn a bi-gram model using this data. Show the probabilities of all the words and  
  estimate the probability for the sentence "Cats are lovely creatures".  
  
  C)         How does the Viterbi algorithm work in the context of part-of-speech tagging, and how  
  can it be beneficial in resolving ambiguity when finalizing the POS tags for a given       (2)  
  sentence?  
  
  5)              Explain two common kinds of structural ambiguity like attachment ambiguity and  
  coordination ambiguity that occurs during Parsing?  
  (3)  
  A)  
  B)         Consider the given grammar and the string "The dog chased the cat in the street". Using  
  CKY parsing algorithm parse the string and show the recognition table.  
  
  S -> NP VP  
  NP -> Det N | NP PP  
  VP -> V NP | VP PP                                                                         (5)  
  PP -> P NP  
  Det -> a | the  
  N -> cat | dog | street  
  V -> chased | caught  
  P -> in | with  
  
  C)         Compare top-down parsing vs bottom-up parsing?                                             (2)  
  
  -----End-----
